analysis: Examined MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift head lines 1-1012. The changes visible in these units are as follows. Lines 513-520 add a GLM media refusal when GLM5NextPromptPolicy.withholdsOutput is true, meaning a JSON response_format or a required/named tool_choice combined with image or video input. This is a fail-closed pre-work refusal. It fires releaseBox before throwing and occurs before any media gate reservation, decode or tower work, so no reservation leak or unvalidated-output path is introduced. Lines 985-988, 1002 and 1006 compute withholdsGLMOutput for the text path. This routes GLM reasoning through the native typed-channel prefix and passes recordsWithheldOutput to makeDeadlineCheckedEventStream. Output is withheld until validation, which tightens rather than loosens tool/JSON enforcement. Cache scope plumbing (requestCacheScope at lines 442-443, 718 and 952) and the cacheEnabled gating are unchanged, so T-041/SEC-035 salt scoping is unaffected. No encryption, attestation, billing or authorization path is touched in these units. Remaining changed ranges (head 1126, 1153, 1187, 1231-1241, 1300-1302, 1309, 1419, 1470, 1490-1493, 1590, 1597-1598) lie outside these units and should be checked by another pass. That check matters most for the makeDeadlineCheckedEventStream handling of recordsWithheldOutput: withheld GLM output must be validated and discarded on failure, never flushed as plaintext partial output, and usage/billing accounting must stay correct for withheld output. GLM5NextPromptPolicy.withholdsOutput's implementation was not supplied.
